templates.ai_not_configured_message:
AI-assisted copy is optional and needs your own API key.

1. Open Settings → General → AI Copy Tools
2. Choose a provider preset (OpenAI-compatible, Azure OpenAI, or Anthropic)
3. Paste your API key (AI_API_KEY)
4. For Azure, set the resource URL, deployment name, and api-version; for Anthropic, use the Messages API base URL
5. Save Settings, then try again.

No AI SDK is bundled; the app calls the HTTP API directly.

This cloud action needs an internet connection to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Proton Drive, or your S3 endpoint.

settings.cloud_offline_restore_message:
Cloud restore needs the selected provider online.

• Connect to the internet and open Settings → Cloud Backup again
• Refresh the backup list, then restore
• Or use Restore from Local File… / open a .tmas-backup.zip via file association (offline)
• Local data stays unchanged until a download succeeds
• If a pre-restore snapshot path appears in the details below, that file is safe to keep
settings.cloud_help: Build a .tmas-backup.zip of your database and upload it to Google Drive, S3-compatible storage (AWS, MinIO, R2, Wasabi, B2), Dropbox, OneDrive, or Proton Drive (official CLI session). Restore downloads the selected backup and replaces the local SQLite database. Offline: Export for Handoff (DB + sessions) or Restore from Local File / OS file association. Desktop remains single-operator; multi-user roles belong to SendGram. Cloud restore requires network access; offline cloud attempts leave local data unchanged.

settings.plugin_registry_help: HTTPS URL of the curated plugin catalog JSON. Leave the default to use the official GitHub registry. Offline, the app falls back to the bundled catalog.
settings.web_companion_token_placeholder: Optional on localhost; required for non-localhost binds

settings.web_companion_help: Optional stdlib HTTP monitor (no extra dependency). Read-only JSON + dashboard with live SVG charts (activity, status, campaigns, health), account/campaign tables, and recent activity. Default bind is 127.0.0.1. Non-localhost binds require an auth token (Bearer / X-TMAS-Token / ?token=). Enable Auto-start with GUI to start the monitor in the background when the desktop app launches (browser is not opened). Prefer keeping the process on localhost behind Caddy/nginx with TLS — see docs/configuration.md. Desktop remains the control surface; CLI: telegram-sender web-monitor --token …
